hero.summary:
I have done Java work from detailed design through testing. I also build APIs and integrations with Spring and TypeScript (NestJS).
From 2024, I taught an internal Java course for beginners for about seven months, with about five trainees per instructor. In delivery work I use Claude Code to read specifications and draft tests.
hero.highlight: Public demos: Ops Inbox API (Nest webhooks) and Laravel Outbound API. Client work includes Java changes for public-sector, finance, and HR systems, and a Java-to-TypeScript move for a healthcare app.

Projects.demoNoteDb: Hosted DB may be offline on the free tier when another sample is using the slot.

opsInboxApi.title: Ops Inbox API — Signed Webhook Ingest (public sample)
opsInboxApi.description: Portfolio proof for NestJS integration work: HMAC-verified webhooks, idempotent storage on retries, OpenAPI, and one recorded outbound notify (mock by default). Built for fixed-price / Upwork-style API briefs.

laravelOutboundApi.title: Laravel Outbound API — Integration Module (public sample)
laravelOutboundApi.description: Portfolio proof for Laravel spot work: validated notify endpoint, mock or HTTP outbound call with persisted audit rows, PHPUnit + smoke, hosted on Render. Shows API glue without shipping vendor secrets.

javaTraining.title: Internal Java training for beginners
javaTraining.description: From 2024, taught an internal course for people new to programming for about seven months, with about five trainees per instructor. Topics: Java basics, file I/O batch programs, JUnit, SQL on MySQL and PostgreSQL, Servlet/JSP, Spring MVC and Spring Boot, Git, and Linux. Also reviewed code and design docs, tracked progress, and wrote the course materials.

medicalApp.title: Healthcare web and mobile app with AI-related features
medicalApp.description: Built a new messaging feature for a healthcare platform and moved the existing Java system to TypeScript (NestJS). Joined to recover a late project (6 months, 47 people). Rebuilt the structure with DDD and revised the API and database. Used Claude Code to read the Java code and continue the migration, then checked generated code for business rules and security. Shipped Android (Kotlin) changes and tested them on device. iOS was static review only.

vulnerabilityPlatform.title: Vulnerability Management SaaS — Platform Development & Operations
vulnerabilityPlatform.description: Added backend features and refactored a vulnerability-management SaaS. Integrated external APIs, unified exception handling, and standardized the dev environment with Docker and WSL2.

hrSystem.title: Enterprise HR Management System
hrSystem.description: Legal-compliance updates on an enterprise HR system. Detailed design, implementation, and unit testing across a multi-year engagement.

senior.detail: Taught an internal Java course for beginners for about seven months. Also added features on a vulnerability-management SaaS in PHP (Laravel), and moved a healthcare app from Java to TypeScript / NestJS. Set up automated tests and a Docker / WSL2 development environment.

midlevel.detail: Spent about three years on legal-compliance updates for an enterprise HR platform. Did detailed design, implementation, and unit testing in Java, PostgreSQL, and Oracle.

junior.detail: Started on government and finance systems. On a public employment-service system, work ran from basic design through integration testing. On an individual pension system, work was unit testing. Mainly Java and SQL.
